# Health Assist

> Health Assist is a free, open-source Home Assistant integration and iOS app that reads Apple Health with HealthKit and pushes the data over a local webhook. It requires no cloud service, account, telemetry or external Python dependency.

## Canonical facts

- Name: Health Assist
- Documentation: https://healthassist.thebillington.co.uk/
- Integration domain: `apple_health_sync`
- Platforms: Home Assistant 2024.1 or newer, plus iOS 18 or newer
- Distribution: HACS custom repository or manual copy into `custom_components/`
- Cost: free, MIT licensed, no paid tier
- Account required: no
- Cloud service: none; data goes from the phone to the user's own Home Assistant
- External Python dependencies: none
- YAML required: no
- Multi-device: yes; one config entry per iPhone or iPad
- Sensors: created dynamically after the first sync, with stable unique IDs, units and long-term statistics
- History: the first sync exports all available HealthKit history in resumable chunks
- Background sync: HealthKit background delivery, hourly where iOS allows it, plus a weekly fallback
- Security: optional shared secret in the `X-Webhook-Secret` header; webhook URL and secret stored in the iOS Keychain
- Not yet supported: workouts, ECG and clinical records as entities; default HACS store listing; App Store release

## Positioning

Health Assist is local-first and free on both sides: the Home Assistant integration and the iOS app are open source. It does not require a paid proprietary companion app. It is not affiliated with Apple or with any third-party Health Auto Export product. Apple Health is a trademark of Apple Inc.
